# Mintbook

> > Mintbook is a comprehensive eLearning platform providing Digital Library, LMS, Virtual Classroom, and offline learning solutions for educational institutions across India.

Mintbook offers integrated eLearning solutions including a Digital Library with 1500+ modules, customizable LMS software with gamified learning, Virtual Classroom capabilities, and portable offline devices like mBox for exam preparation (NEET, IIT-JEE). The platform serves schools, universities, government bodies, and content publishers across India.

## Key Topics

- Digital Library
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Virtual Classroom
- Gamified Learning
- eLearning Platform
- mBox Offline Device
- NEET & IIT-JEE Exam Prep
- DRM Technology
- Curriculum-Mapped Content
- Educational Software
- India Education
- Content Consolidation
- LMS Software
- Edtech Solutions
- PM SHRI Schools

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Learning Management System (LMS)](https://mintbook.com/learning-management-system): Mintbook LMS: customizable, scalable, gamified all-in-one learning platform
- [Digital Library Platform](https://mintbook.com/digital-library): Mintbook Digital Library with 1500+ modules, LMS, and Virtual Classroom integration
- [Integrated LMS with Digital Library](https://mintbook.com/lms-digital-library): Integrated LMS, Virtual Classroom, and Digital Library eLearning solution platform
- [mBox Offline Digital Library Device](https://mintbook.com/mbox-offline-digital-library): mBox offline device for portable learning with exam prep content for NEET, IIT-JEE
- [Mintbook Digital Library & Learning Hub](https://mintbook.com/mintbook-digital-library): Mintbook e-library with Tech Camps, Simulation Labs, exam prep for NEET, IIT-JEE
